summary: Three climbers stranded after dark on the Naked Edge route in Eldorado Canyon without headlamps; RMRG reached the lead climber at ~10:30pm and rappelled to the lower pair, all out uninjured by ~2:25am
location: Naked Edge, Eldorado Canyon State Park
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain Rescue Group + Boulder County Sheriff, Boulder Emergency Squad
notes: Benighted without headlamps; drone assistance from Boulder Emergency Squad
